result.Method of Attack: Info stealer using phishing email with malicious attachment; steals browser data, keylogging, webcam extraction, system info collection, file exfiltration, screenshot capture; includes ransomware functionality (Kodex Ransomware) encrypting files with password-protected archives
result.Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious attachment disguised as Adobe PDF or Dropbox file; execution via Python program packaged by PyInstaller and .NET loader with embedded PowerShell script
